name: Aten Ra
inspiration: Aten, Ra/Re, Ma’at, Khepri, Set/Sutekh, Isis/Iset, Maahes, Amun/Amunet, pharaonic regalia, Nile/Red Land cosmology, and Egyptian temple/afterlife symbolism — treated as human echoes of the older Aten Ra Realm.
philosophy: Solar kingship demands noon judgment — the instant when the sun judges everything beneath it without shadow, without mercy, without negotiation. Ma'at is not mercy: it is cosmic accountability. Order exists BECAUSE chaos (Set) provides something to weigh. The hidden (Amunet) exists because visible power needs an invisible root. Every deity serves the solar order.
culture: An extradimensional solar civilization whose living sun-disc anatomy, falcon-crowned sovereignty, Ma'at judgment circuits, radiating hand-rays, scarab renewal, throne-magic, Nile-river rites, and Red Land storm wardens are the TRUE forms that human Egyptian myth recorded as distorted echoes. Pharaohs copied Aten Ra's Gate-born crown and collar after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. Isis's hekau magic was the real source of Egyptian priestess-craft. Set's chaos was the real desert storm humans blamed for famine. Amunet's hidden power was the truth behind Egyptian mystery cults.
visualIdentity: Electrum-gold radiance skin, Nile-black glass shadow planes, red desert jasper fault lines. Falcon-crowned helms. Sun-disc crests with Uraeus cobra. Khopesh swords and Ma'at law shields. Wesekh collars with lapis-blue and turquoise inlay. Amber-gold solar aura on body, weapons, and armor. Divine bronze war-boots with solar-disc knee-guards.
combatPhilosophy: Hold the field through Ma’at: solar command zones, judgment beams, renewal engines, river sustain, desert disruption, lion interception, hidden-name execution, and anti-chaos rites against Isfet.
factionPassive: Solar Law: coordinated deities gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.

sourceCultureRule: HUMAN_EGYPTIAN_LORE_AS_ECHO: Pharaohs copied Aten-Ra's Gate-born crown, collar, and solar hand-rays after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. Isis's hekau gestures were copied by priestesses. Set's storm was the real desert chaos humans blamed. Amunet's veiled power became the Egyptian mystery cults. The solar barque journey humans recorded is Aten-Ra's actual patrol route.

culture: An extradimensional oath-bound storm civilization whose rune-scarred storm-iron bodies, raven-shadow wisdom, wolf-guarded halls, fate-woven threads, thunder-hammer strength, and Valkyrie battle-choice are the TRUE forms that human Norse myth recorded as distorted saga echoes. Norse skalds remembered Odin's blue cloak and pale eye from dreams of the Storm-Rooted Holds. Freyja's tears of gold were the real source of treasure-hoarding myths. Frigg's silent knowing was the truth behind Norse fate-weaving. Thor's red beard and thunder were the real storms humans feared.
visualIdentity: Warm gunmetal skin with forge-heat bronze undertone (ALIVE, not dead). Blue-white lightning in veins. Rune-wound scars burned into flesh. Storm-iron and ash-wood weapons. Raven-feather shadow and wolf-fur accents. Cloud-like mantles. Blue-white lightning + warm gunmetal aura. Rune-worn war-boots with lightning in the seams.
combatPhilosophy: Endure through oath, counter through storm, bind allies through shield-wall law, harvest fallen courage, and weaponize Ragnarok pressure before the Hollow can make doom meaningless.

Artemis's bow was the real hunt humans celebrated. Ares's bloodlust was the real war humans endured.

combatPhilosophy: Win through contest: expose weakness, declare trials, control arenas, punish hubris, crown decisive strikes, and transform battlefield rivalry into ascension pressure.

name: Kami
inspiration: Kami as nature/ancestor/spirit phenomena, Shinto shrine thresholds, torii crossings, purification, sacred rope and paper shide, mirror/sword/jewel regalia echoes, kitsune foxfire, tengu mountain winds, oni punishment force, dragon rain, moonlit yōkai liminality, onmyōdō yin-yang divination, ink, masks, lacquer, and seasonal weather — treated as Earth’s echo of the older Sacred Kingdoms.
philosophy: Sacred sovereignty demands RITUAL ORDER — but acknowledges that chaos (Susanoo) and death (Izanami) are part of the sacred cycle. Amaterasu's sun IS the highest authority. Tsukuyomi's moon provides necessary counterpoint. Susanoo's storms are destructive but heroic. Izanami's death is the cost of creation. Every deity serves the sacred cycle of sun, moon, storm, and death.
culture: An extradimensional shrine-realm civilization whose living lacquer bodies, sacred mirror sovereignty, moon-bow precision, storm-sword chaos, and creation-death duality are the TRUE forms that human Japanese/Shinto myth recorded as distorted ritual echoes. Japanese shrines were built in mimicry of Amaterasu's real Takamagahara. The sun/moon split between Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi was the real cosmic separation humans recorded as myth. Susanoo's serpent-slaying was the real storm that humans celebrated. Izanami's death and Yomi rule was the real underworld humans feared.
visualIdentity: Living lacquer skin (warm ivory-gold for Amaterasu, silver for Tsukuyomi, dark for Susanoo, split for Izanami). Red-gold imperial flame + moonlight silver aura. Sacred mirrors, magatama beads, Totsuka swords. Torii-gate and shrine architecture. Boots for sun/moon/storm deities. Demon-like ghostly feet for Izanami (death goddess).
combatPhilosophy: Control thresholds: misdirect through foxfire, purify corruption, bind spirits, shift terrain through shrine law, and punish trespassers who cross sacred boundaries wrongly.

The sun/moon split between Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi was the real cosmic separation humans recorded as the Uke Mochi myth. Susanoo's Orochi-slaying was the real storm event. Izanami's Yomi descent was the real creation of death.

Abundance, inspiration, mastery, and death are the four pillars. Every deity serves the cycle of growth, fire, skill, and inevitable doom.
culture: An extradimensional fae-sovereign memory civilization whose living wood-bark bodies, earth-abundance, battle-crow fate, triple-flame inspiration, and many-skilled radiance are the TRUE forms that human Celtic/Irish myth recorded as distorted folklore echoes. The Morrigan's battle-crows were the real doom-omens humans feared. Lugh's mastery was the real skill-hope humans celebrated.

Fae, nature-connected, non-human but beautiful. Boots for Dagda, Brigid, Lugh. Raven-talon feet for Morrigan (animal-like shapeshifter).

mythosGatesIdentity.dungeonCrawlerFunction: Empyrean provides divine playable characters, creatures, sacred locations, hazards, artifacts, and meaningful dungeon routes for Mythos Gates: Ascension.
mythosGatesIdentity.expansionRule: Future Mythos Gates subtitles may reveal deeper Gate routes or new connections without rewriting this faction canon.
mythosGatesIdentity.ascensionDungeonType: vertical cathedral ascent and judgment machinery
mythosGatesIdentity.activeChapterRule: Ascension is a one selected god or goddess dungeon-crawler campaign, not a squad war campaign.
mythosGatesIdentity.routeLoreFunction: Empyrean expresses its Realm law through Choir-Vault Discord Ascent, where one selected playable deity crosses The Choir-Vault Gate and confronts Hollow pressure, route-native hazards, elite locks, treasure/lore detours, and a boss chamber without resolving the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

renderSilhouetteSkinLock: Faction render silhouette/skin lock: Empyrean bodies are choir-radiance anatomy — opal glass, white-gold flame, many-eye aura veils, bell bronze, scroll-seal skin, wing geometry, cathedral-vault curves, ophanim arcs that serve anatomy; never ordinary buff humans in angel armor.
uniqueRealmLookBible: Empyrean unique look bible: gods from the Empyrean Choir must read as radiant hierarchy anatomy — opal glass bodies, white-gold inner flame, many-eye veil motifs, bell-bronze joints, living scroll seals, wing geometry or non-winged sacred geometry according to rank, choral vibration lines, cathedral-vault anatomy, ophanim arcs as divine mechanics not halos.
crossRealmDriftBan: Cross-realm drift ban: never render Empyrean with Aten Ra pharaonic gold/linen, Asgardian runes/furs, Olympian marble/laurel civic bodies, Kami shrine lacquer/shide, Tuatha bark/fae root-lace, or Infernal horns/chains/volcanic contract court.
renderDifferentiationRule: This faction must be recognizable from silhouette and skin/material language alone before symbols, labels, weapons, or colors are added.
mythology_source: Abrahamic: Book of Revelation, Book of Daniel, Enoch, Pistis Sophia, Kabbalah
realm_basis: The Radiant Hierarchies - based on Abrahamic angelology: angelic choirs, archangels, Pleroma. Abrahamic churches/cathedrals copied the Empyrean Hierarchies.
footwear: All Empyrean deities wear divine boots with holy-fire and radiant energy. No bare feet — these are celestial warriors, sages, and heralds.
primary_sources: Book of Revelation, Book of Daniel, Book of Enoch, Pistis Sophia, Zohar (Kabbalah), Wisdom of Solomon

name: Infernal Dominion
inspiration: underworld punishment realms, demon kings and devils, infernal contracts, black iron courts, chains, volcanic glass, ash, horns, wings, claws, temptation, sin taxonomies, hellfire, judges of the damned, grimoires, goetic seals, and abyssal prisons — treated as Earth’s echo of the older Infernal Dominion.
philosophy: Infernal sovereignty demands PRIDE and CONTRACT — Lucifer rules through charisma and ambition, Lilith through independence and dark beauty, Asmodeus through desire and destruction, Naamah through enchantment and subtlety. Every infernal deal is a CONTRACT — the Dominion is not chaos, it is a LEGAL empire with rules, courts, and binding agreements. The Fall was not a mistake — it was a CHOICE. Freedom through defiance.
culture: An extradimensional infernal legal empire whose living ash bodies, fallen-gold light, shadow-seduction, hellfire appetite, and velvet-dark enchantment are the TRUE forms that human demonology recorded as distorted cautionary echoes. Infernal contracts and grimoire seals were human attempts to replicate the Dominion's real legal code. Lucifer's Fall was the real rebellion humans recorded as Isaiah's morning-star prophecy. Lilith's independence was the real first refusal humans demonized. Asmodeus's destruction was the real lust-fury humans feared. Naamah's enchantment was the real seduction humans warned against.
visualIdentity: Living ash skin (dark obsidian-black with ember-red cracks). Fallen gold + dark amber + hellfire aura. NO wings (fallen but not winged — the Empyrean don't have wings either). Demon-like feet — no boots. Clawed, shadow-taloned, or hellfire-claw feet. Precious stone inlays (Lucifer's original angelic gems, now darkened).
combatPhilosophy: Win by terms: bind enemies with contracts, tax movement, punish broken bargains, weaponize pain, buy time with debt, and turn battlefield losses into legal ownership.
factionPassive: Dominion Flame: decisive aggression turns enemy weakness into momentum.
mixingRule: Current canon keeps faction identity separated unless a campaign rule explicitly permits a mixed chosen deity.
sourceCultureRule: HUMAN_DEMONOLOGY_LORE_AS_ECHO: Infernal contracts and grimoire seals were human attempts to replicate the Dominion's real legal code. Lucifer's Fall (Isaiah 14, Ezekiel 28) was the real rebellion. Lilith's night-demon status was the human demonization of her real independence. Asmodeus's Book of Tobit appearance was a human echo of his real destructive presence. Naamah's Zohar description was the human recording of her real seductive power. The Ars Goetia's demon hierarchy was a distorted map of the real Dominion's legal structure.
